timeline.message:
Remove IndexingIT#testSyncedFlushTransition

Synced flush was deprecated in 8.0, therefore this test is irrelevant
in later versions.

Closes #79930
timeline.author: Francisco Fernández Castaño

timeline.body:
Synced flush was removed in 8.0, therefore this test is irrelevant
in later versions.

Closes #79930

I would think this test still makes sense and we should instead use `assumeTrue` here? The transition code is still here and should be until we decide to break it completely, i.e., not support mixed clusters to 7.x.
I'm closing this and I'll open a new one with the suggested change.
